title: The Final Cut
case_summary: Superstar producer Kabir Malhotra was found poisoned in his vanity van on a Mumbai film set at 23:00. He was known for destroying careers and blackmailing actors. His death happened during a power outage, meaning anyone could have slipped something into his coffee.

victim.name: Kabir Malhotra
victim.background: A powerful producer who used blackmail and drugs to control his actors.
victim_relationships: Zoya (Actress): Kabir was blackmailing her with a scandal.
Arjun (Director): Kabir was going to replace him with a younger director.
Rahul (Spot Boy): Kabir humiliated him and refused to pay medical bills.
Fatima (Manager): Kabir was stealing money from her.

solution.logical_rule: Zoya's alibi fails when the cyanide vial and blackmail photos are found.

suspects.name: Zoya Khan
suspects.relationships: You hate Kabir. You think Arjun is spineless.

suspects.name: Arjun Kapoor
suspects.motive: Kabir was going to fire him.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the editing suite.
suspects.relationships: You are jealous of Kabir. You think Zoya is difficult.

suspects.name: Rahul Mehra
suspects.relationships: You are terrified of Kabir. You look up to Arjun.

suspects.name: Fatima Sheikh
suspects.relationships: You are loyal to Kabir. You think Zoya is a brat.

evidence.name: Cyanide Vial
evidence.description: Found in the trash near the vanity van.

evidence.name: Blackmail Photos
evidence.description: Envelope of photos Kabir used against Zoya.
